concerns.text: Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it writes code files (`checkpointing.py`, `main.py`) and creates a checkpoint file during execution. Running this task concurrently with other tasks could cause race conditions on the same filesystem paths, violating the `[P]` guarantee of no hidden shared state. Either remove the `[P]` tag or redesign the task to be truly side‑effect‑free for parallel execution.
